title: Line sketch: Verdant Cabbage Spiral
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A tight close-up reveals the layered, curving leaves of a cabbage spiraling inward toward a dark center with a single highlight. The composition draws the eye into the rosette pattern through overlapping foliage and soft shadows. Bold, visible and smooth color gradients emphasize the plant's organic texture (derived from painting #165).
